title: Movies I Own
description: Every film in the catalog you own on DVD, Blu-ray or digital.

title: The 21st Century's 100 Greatest Films
description: BBC Culture's 2016 poll of 177 film critics from around the world. Three films tied at No. 100.

title: Sight and Sound: The Greatest Films of All Time (2022)
description: The BFI's Sight and Sound poll, held once a decade since 1952. The 2022 edition polled critics and, separately, filmmakers.

lists.title: Sight and Sound 2022: Critics' Poll
lists.description: The top 100 from the ballots of 1,639 critics, programmers, curators, archivists and academics. Six films tied at No. 95.

lists.title: Sight and Sound 2022: Directors' Poll
lists.description: The top 100 from the ballots of 480 filmmakers. Twelve films tied at No. 93, so the list has 104.
